channel.title: Origin of Speech
channel.description: Last 10 notes on Origin of Speech

item.description: दिक्पूर्वपदान्ङीप् 4.1.59 - 4.1.61 SV: दिक्-पूर्वपदात् ङीप् Language Meaning: ङीप् comes after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) which is preceded by a word signifying direction.
दीर्घजिह्वी च च्छन्दसि 4.1.58 - 4.1.60 SV: none AV: ङीष् Language meaning: The form दीर्घजिह्वी ‘long-tongued’ is irregularly formed in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

item.title: ह्वे Explained
item.description: Object Permanence, Indexical Sound, and ह्वे Context All Sanskrit words are made from Paninian elements like धातु, प्रत्यय, उपसर्ग etc.

item.title: लिह्
item.description: लिहँ = ल इ ह चंद्र बिंदी take inward tight pull.

item.title: क्वन्
item.description: क्वन् = क व न maneuver wave pull.

item.title: जिह्व
item.description: जिह्व = ह्वे + ड (द्वित्व) जिह्वी = ह्वे + ड (द्वित्व) + ङीष् - exist connected to speech - fear - outside object pointed जिह्व = लिह् + क्वन्.

item.title: ह्वे
item.description: ह्वेञ् = ह व ए ञ संप्रदान (exists wave) skin connection at exist-wave - surface/skin existence received (in) speech रूढ अर्थ स्पर्धा = स्पर्ध् + अङ् + टाप् शब्द = Erect speech give Comment: ह्वे = refers to existence experienced into speech.

item.title: स्पर्ध्
item.description: स्पर्धँ = स प र ध चंद्र बिंदी align rope water carry inside align footing water carry inside align limb water carry inside रूढ अर्थ सङ्घर्ष = सम् + घृष् + घञ् In this context सङ्घर्षे means aligned inside + hunt superior do pointed (referring to tongue and/or teeth) + hunt skin comment: स्पर्धँ and ...

item.title: घृष्
item.description: घृषुँ = घ ऋ ष उ चंद्र बिंदी hunt superior verb)pointed) चंद्र बिंदी hunt hunt subjugated - do pointed skin/outside/inside/pull/push रूढ अर्थ सङ्घर्ष = self circular reference.
नखमुखात् संज्ञायाम् 4.1.57 - 4.1.59 SV: नख-मुखात् संज्ञायाम् AV: ङीष् स्व-अङ्गात् च उपसर्जनात् अ-संयोग-उपधात् न Language Meaning: ष् is not used after १.
